parameters.query:
=SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clients) as total_clients,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pets) as total_pets,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointments WHERE status = 'scheduled' AND appointment_date >= CURRENT_DATE) as upcoming_appointments,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointments WHERE status = 'completed' AND appointment_date = CURRENT_DATE) as today_completed,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointments WHERE appointment_date = CURRENT_DATE + 1 AND status = 'scheduled') as tomorrow_scheduled,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.price), 0) FROM appointments a JOIN services s ON a.service_id = s.id WHERE a.status = 'completed' AND a.appointment_date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)) as month_revenue

=SELECT 
  a.appointment_date,
  a.appointment_time,
  c.first_name,
  c.last_name,
  c.phone,
  p.name as pet_name,
  p.breed as pet_breed,
  s.name as service_name,
  s.price
FROM appointments a
JOIN clients c ON a.client_id = c.id
JOIN pets p ON a.pet_id = p.id
JOIN services s ON a.service_id = s.id
WHERE a.appointment_date = CURRENT_DATE + 1
  AND a.status = 'scheduled'
ORDER BY a.appointment_time
